Eyewitnesses reported seeing smoke billowing from the vehicle as emergency responders arrived to extinguish the flames and assist those injured. The chaos unfolded when Samuel Ovie Abutoh, a 59-year-old man, allegedly rammed the Hummer into the diner intentionally. Following the crash, Abutoh reportedly doused himself in a flammable liquid and set himself on fire, escalating the tragic series of events. The incident attracted a large police and fire department response, highlighting serious safety concerns surrounding such unforeseen violent actions.
